subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers continue repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a sibling candidate with broader renderer coverage and proof?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same approval-copy bug, and this branch still has a concrete native Telegram renderer gap plus a contributor real-proof gate.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, require native Telegram reason propagation plus real prompt proof, and use it as the landing path only after the gap is fixed.

options.title: Promote a sibling canonical fix
options.body: If a sibling PR has broader maintained coverage and stronger proof, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch only after the canonical fix is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require native Telegram reason propagation plus real prompt proof, and use it as the landing path only after the gap is fixed.
